title: Too Many Choices
caption:
Around 150 companies. Where do you even start?

Too much choice leads to jumping between charts and never really learning any of them.

Start small: pick a few stocks and learn how they move, or start with an index like the MSI 50. And the Daily Chart gives everyone the same single chart, every day.

Find your first few stocks at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.
